text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means making goals specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and understand what needs to be done. It is also important to define milestones, which mark key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, which are the final products or results. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures everyone involved agrees on the goals and expectations from the beginning. When these elements are combined, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
